# Email configuration

Configure the default sender used by `sendEmail()`.

```json
{
  "email": {
    "from": "Acme <noreply@mail.acme.com>"
  }
}
```

| Field  | Type     | Description                                                                 |
| ------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `from` | `string` | Default sender for `sendEmail()`: one address (`Acme <noreply@mail.acme.com>`) |
